title: Renew a design or building practitioner registration for a body corporate
summary: Directors or public officers of a body corporate can renew their design or building practitioner registration online when the registration is nearing expiry.
intro:
If you're the director or public officer of a body corporate currently holding design practitioner or building practitioner registration(s), you'll receive a renewal notice when the registration is nearing its expiry date. You are then able to renew your registration online.

Note: If the body corporate has had a change of name or ABN, please ensure you complete NSW Fair Trading's Change of Details – PDF prior to renewing your registration.

If you need to update your ACN you're required to lodge a new application.
who_can_apply: Meet the criteria for design practitioner body corporate or building practitioner body corporate
what_you_need: Your renewal number (as shown on your renewal notice)
A current credit card for payment

how_to_steps.text: Log in to your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to renew your registration.

more_info.text: If you don't renew on time you'll have to make an application to restore your registration.
If your registration has expired more than 3 months, you'll need to apply for a new registration to be issued.
You cannot work if your registration is expired.
To find your registration number and details, visit Verify.licence.

faqs.q: What should I do if the body corporate has changed its name or ABN?
faqs.a: You must complete NSW Fair Trading's Change of Details – PDF before renewing your registration.

faqs.q: If I need to update my ACN, what do I need to do?
faqs.a: You are required to lodge a new application.

faqs.q: How do I renew my registration online?
faqs.a: Gather the required documents, select the ‘Renew online’ button, log in to your MyServiceNSW Account, and follow the prompts.
